definitions.autism: a mental condition characterized by great difficulty in communicating with others and in using language and abstract concepts.
definitions.muso: a musician, especially one over-concerned with technique.
definitions.opium: an addictive drug prepared from the juice of a poppy (Papaver somniferum), used illicitly as a narcotic and occasionally in medicine as an analgesic.
definitions.opus: a separate composition or set of compositions.
definitions.oust: drive out or expel from a position or place.
definitions.possum: a tree-dwelling Australasian marsupial, typically with a prehensile tail.
definitions.potassium: the chemical element of atomic number 19, a soft silvery-white reactive metal of the alkali-metal group. (Symbol: K).
definitions.pout: push one's lips or bottom lip forward as an expression of petulant annoyance or in order to make oneself look sexually attractive.
definitions.puma: a large American wild cat with a plain tawny to greyish coat, found from Canada to Patagonia.
definitions.smut: a small flake of soot or dirt.
definitions.soup: a savoury liquid dish made by boiling meat, fish, or vegetables in stock or water.
definitions.spout: a projecting tube or lip through or over which liquid can be poured from a container.
definitions.stump: the part of a tree trunk left projecting from the ground after the rest has fallen or been felled.
definitions.suit: a set of outer clothes made of the same fabric and designed to be worn together, typically consisting of a jacket and trousers or a jacket and skirt.
definitions.sumo: a Japanese form of heavyweight wrestling.
definitions.sump: the base of an internal-combustion engine, which serves as a reservoir of oil for the lubrication system.
definitions.upmost: highest in place, rank, or importance.
